info.name: Multi-Agent Workflow API
info.description: multi-agent system for software workflow automation.

request.description: Verify the API server is running.

item.name: Run Workflow – Ollama (live inference, with fallback)

request.description: Trigger the full multi-agent workflow. Tries live Ollama inference first; if Ollama is unreachable or times out, falls back to the template generator and still returns status: completed. Requires `docker compose up -d` and `ollama pull llama3` for live inference.

response.name: 200 Completed – Ollama live inference
200 Completed – template_fallback (Ollama timed out)

item.name: Run Workflow – No fallback (strict Ollama failure)

request.description: Strict mode: if Ollama is unreachable or times out, the workflow stops immediately and returns status: failed with generation_source: ollama_failed. No template fallback.

response.name: 200 Failed – Ollama unreachable (no fallback)

request.description: Same workflow with template fallback enabled. If Ollama is unreachable, generation falls back to a structured Markdown template.
Use a different local model (phi3). Run `ollama pull phi3` before testing this request.
Validates that an empty/whitespace requirement is rejected with HTTP 400.
